_comment: Generated by tools/build_map.py from data/parsed and data/src. During Phase 1, edit those inputs, not this file.

basin.name: The Basin
basin.axes: +x trailing, -x spinward, +y coreward, -y rimward, z depth; light-years; origin near Ostrom

alignments.name: The crossroads
alignments.notes: Stewardship and the powers living off its markets. Richest and best armed.

alignments.name: The Gap Accord
alignments.notes: Informal partnership using the Halvard Gap to bypass Ostrom. Agreed at Halvard's Rest, 5026u. No treaty, no council.

alignments.name: The trailing traders
alignments.notes: Open lanes and low tolls. Most ships, least territory.

factions.name: The Stewardship
leaders: Steward-Admiral Odile Kasprzak (78, unseen since early summer)
Cdre Isaac Ferrante (Tallis garrison, Long Watch)
factions.strength: Carrier Kestrel Accord; battleships Severn, Coriolis; 24 smaller warships; ~30,000 marines; ~120,000 in uniform. Pickets at Cinder and Brace.
factions.notes: Union Navy Battlegroup XI. Levies 1/10 of lattice crossing. Internal camps: Long Watch vs Restorationists.

factions.name: The Charter Bench
factions.notes: Civil branch: courts, the Allotment, fleet archive (license library). Petitioning that the drone ends the mandate.

factions.name: The Survey Office
factions.notes: Stations in the Pale and the Orrery; Ashlar quarantine; funds THRESHOLD's platform.

factions.name: The Gloam Purview
factions.strength: ~20,000 troops; 8 frigates and corvettes; orbital guns on Gloam's lane mouths. 2,000 troops on Scald.
factions.notes: Harrison Armory holding. ~110,000 people. Taxes entry to the Shoals.

factions.name: The Wayfarer Synod
factions.strength: Pilgrim Guard ~6,000 with Smith-Shimano frames; ~30 armed hulls.
factions.notes: Theocracy, ~70,000 on Pennant plus ~20,000 congregants elsewhere. Venerates SEXTANT. Calendar follows the 73-day Lantern tide.

factions.name: The Glass Syndicate
factions.alignmentNote: Divided: the Northern Concord with the crossroads, the Southern League with the Gap Accord
factions.notes: Claim-holders' consortium; registry kept by ARBITRAGE. Split since 5027u into the Northern Concord and the Southern League. 30-40 free companies under contract.

factions.name: Northern Concord
factions.notes: Exclusive contracts with Smith-Shimano and the Assay House; leased Navy frame companies and Saltmarsh.

factions.name: Southern League
factions.notes: Backed by Kerr-Varga, Dunmore Rifles and the Purview. Sells via Ferrous/Halvard Gap or Tarn/Sable Run.

factions.name: Mercer-Ibarra
factions.strength: ~5,000 troops, 600 frames, 6 armed ships at the Gap.
factions.notes: Holds the Halvard Gap and charges passage. Still sells to the Assay House.

factions.name: The Compact
factions.notes: Settler insurgency since Dry Creek (5027u). Armed by the Seventh and Kerr-Varga.

factions.name: Tallis Landholders' League
factions.notes: ~30,000 veterans with land titles. Political base of the Long Watch. Own frame lances.

factions.name: The Orison Assembly
factions.notes: Elected council of ~40,000 settlers seeking evacuation.

factions.name: The Coldwell Claims
factions.notes: ~6,000 independent miners with Allotment claims. Purview has cleared 11 camps, deported ~900.

factions.name: The Lagoon Towns of Wending
factions.notes: The Moorage federation of ~30 floating towns, ~30,000 people. Harbor guard only.

factions.name: The Bellows Commune
factions.notes: ~4,000 settlers in sealed towns.

factions.name: Saltmarsh Company
factions.notes: Navy standing contract since 5021u. Recently pulled 200 frames off the Seam to the Marrow, unexplained.

factions.name: The Cormorant Regulars
factions.notes: Free Lines escorts. Fighting the Tallymen on the Sable Run.

factions.name: Dunmore Rifles
factions.notes: Founded 5021u by Armory veterans who left Gloam. Largest company on the Southern League line.

factions.name: Lantern Company
factions.seatDetail: under siege on the southern continent
factions.notes: First-landing specialists. Cut off since early 5029u.

factions.name: Gallowglass
factions.notes: Boarding specialists working for the Basin Office in the hull war. Took 9 ships.

factions.name: The Ninefold
factions.notes: Top-rated on PATIENCE's board.

factions.name: The Captains' Table
factions.notes: Delegate body for free companies. No troops.

factions.name: The Seventh
factions.notes: 7th Marine Expeditionary Regiment, mutinied 5019u. Raids Navy and Purview.

factions.name: The Unlit
factions.notes: Dark-running rimward raiders. Can navigate the Mire's local lanes.

factions.name: The Tallymen
factions.notes: Sell protection (the tally) on the Sable Run. Dock at Sable.

factions.name: The Ringwreckers
factions.notes: Salvage gangs stripping Tarn's Absent shipyard.

factions.name: Halloran's Heirs
factions.strength: A few hundred raiders, ~12 fast ships.
factions.notes: Prey on Synod shipping and Orison refugees. Anchorage thought to be on the Orison–Orrery lane.

factions.name: The Assay House
factions.notes: Lattice exchange; sets the Basin price; manages the Navy reserve.

factions.name: IPS-N Basin Office
factions.notes: Holds the Ostrom yards. Hull war with the Free Lines. Claims Tarn's yards.

factions.name: The Free Lines
factions.notes: Shipping cooperative. LONGSHORE plans convoys.

factions.name: Corvel Cartographic
factions.alignmentNote: Works with everyone, trusted by no one
factions.notes: Chart seller. Most claims in the Lantern Reach; Pennant southern continent landing. Gets charts from WAYMARK yearly.

factions.name: Smith-Shimano
factions.alignmentNote: Buys and sells through the crossroads without quite belonging to it
factions.notes: Builds the most expensive frames. Sells to Navy, Purview and Synod.

factions.name: Ostrom Standard Mechanical
factions.notes: Cheap GMS-pattern frames for Navy auxiliaries and the League.

factions.name: Kerr-Varga Lattice Works
factions.notes: Kerrtown ~30,000 people. Sells to both sides. Racing to mine Cairn.

factions.name: Ferrous Consolidated
factions.notes: Printer feed foundries. Boneyard salvage concessions (~2,000 people).

factions.name: Rimelight Extraction
factions.alignmentNote: Sells to all; to the trailing traders when the Assay House price is poor
factions.notes: Four stations on three rogue worlds. Staging at Sable; receiving at Tarn.

factions.name: The Gatherers' Guild
factions.notes: Gathers Furnace lattice.

factions.name: The Riverlands Combine
factions.notes: Farms the Tallis river valleys; feeds the inner Basin.

factions.name: The Long Families
factions.notes: Six Cosmopolitan houses. Hold the Wending passage. Run Stillwater.

factions.name: Sable Harbor
factions.notes: Free port run by harbormasters. No army.

factions.name: The Reach companies
factions.alignmentNote: Verdance Colonial Company backed by Corvel; Stillwater Platform Company run by the Long Families
factions.notes: Verdance Colonial Company (Corvel) and Stillwater Platform Company (Long Families).

factions.name: The Exchange
factions.notes: Commercial deck; contract board run by PATIENCE.

factions.name: The Vigil of the Open Door
factions.notes: Watches the gate. Tripled since the drone (~39,000).

factions.name: The Gardeners
factions.notes: Absent machinery held in trust; some attack lattice shipments.

factions.name: The Listeners
factions.notes: Miners who believe the Absent speak through lattice. Some sabotage.

feuds.name: The Reach insurgency
feuds.over: Land and the thaw on Tallis

feuds.name: The Orison tide
feuds.over: A back door into the coreward arm

regions.name: Ostrom
regions.label: gate, Marrow
regions.notes: Six primary lane mouths: Tallis, Gloam, Scald and the three Silent Mouths.

regions.name: The Pale
regions.label: dead stars
regions.notes: Dim, cold, airless worlds. A repeating Absent signal broadcasts every 41 hours from somewhere inside; source never found. Survey Office research station.

lattice.where: Veins in the central structure only

regions.name: Halyard
regions.label: Free Lines
regions.notes: Comets and ice moons; water and reaction mass for the trailing arm.

lattice.where: Seams in the orange dwarfs' metal worlds

regions.name: The Furnace
regions.label: nebula
regions.notes: Stellar nursery. Radiation blinds sensors and burns unshielded electronics. Even local lanes drift. Unidentified anchorages deep inside. Visible from Lumen's moon.

regions.name: The Hollows
regions.label: rogue worlds

lattice.where: Seams under the ice of rogue worlds

regions.notes: No stars. Rogue planets kept warm by Absent heat engines; liquid oceans under ice. Rimelight runs four stations on three rogue worlds (lost a fifth to the Unlit). Local lanes short and stable.

lattice.where: Seams through the frozen night side
Thin seams on a few moons
Shallow seams on small worlds; Choir's rings (exceptional)

regions.name: Ferrous
regions.label: foundries
regions.notes: Almost no planets; dense metal-rich asteroid belts. The Basin's largest foundries are built into the biggest asteroids.

regions.name: Tarn
regions.label: Absent yards
regions.notes: Four lane mouths; one of the busiest rimward junctions.

lattice.where: Shallow seams under the stone fields

control.note: Cairn feud over the native-life protections

regions.name: The Boneyard
regions.label: Absent wrecks
regions.notes: Moon-sized Absent megastructures drifting in loose orbits. Custodians more common here than anywhere. Some wrecks still powered.

regions.name: The Mire
regions.label: dust and drift
regions.notes: Dark dust cloud hiding its stars. Local lanes branch and rejoin unpredictably. Some stars known only from the lanes.

regions.name: The Quiet
regions.label: Silent Mouths
regions.notes: Whatever lies beyond Ostrom's Silent Mouths. Every probe sent in has vanished. Distance unknown.

systems.name: Ostrom
systems.notes: Quiet orange star with six planets, none habitable. The gate hangs well beyond the outermost. The colony hauler Anselm fell into this star at the Closing with eleven thousand sleepers aboard.

systems.name: Cinder
systems._comment: D17: the documents call Cinder a burned-out white dwarf.
systems.notes: A pulsar: the burned-out core of a star that died violently, spinning fast and sweeping the system with radiation. A scatter of airless planets survived the death. Nine hours from Ostrom by local lane. Stewardship picket on the Gloam and Scald lanes.

systems.name: Marl
systems.notes: Red dwarf ringed by a thick asteroid belt. Most of the Marrow's raw material came out of it. A flare star: belt crews shelter when it flares.

systems.name: Tallis
systems.notes: Primary of the garden world Tallis.

systems.name: Brace
systems._comment: D17: the documents call Brace a red dwarf.

lattice.where: Faint traces on the airless worlds

systems.notes: A swollen red giant a few hours trailing of Tallis, filling the sky on that side. It stripped its worlds airless long ago. Holds the lane mouth to Halyard and a Stewardship picket.

systems.name: Marchwell
systems._comment: D17: the documents call Marchwell a brown dwarf.
systems.notes: Dim white dwarf coreward of Tallis, with almost nothing around it except the mouth of the long lane to Pennant.

bodies.name: Ostrom IV
bodies.notes: Thin nitrogen atmosphere and nothing on the surface worth landing for. The Marrow orbits it.

bodies.name: The Marrow
bodies.notes: The Basin's capital, main port and largest market. Built from 5019u around the Charter flagship Bellwether after its drives failed; a dozen hulls stripped in the Requisition were welded on as decks. About two hundred thousand people live aboard. Every hull docking at the Hangar Ring is swept for undeclared lattice and unregistered NHPs.

bodies.name: IPS-N Ostrom yards
bodies.notes: The only place in the Basin that can refit a capital ship.

bodies.name: The gate
bodies.notes: A ring about two thousand kilometers across with no station, no power source anyone has found and no blinkspace signature. The space around it is cleaner of dust and debris than anywhere else in the region. Four months ago it opened for nine seconds and released a single damaged Union courier drone whose clock reads 5371u.

bodies.name: THRESHOLD's platform
bodies.notes: Research platform near the ring, funded by the Survey Office. THRESHOLD has studied the gate from here for most of a decade. Since the drone came through, the Long Watch has proposed bringing it under naval control, and THRESHOLD has been refused access to the drone.

bodies.name: Silent Mouth 1 (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the three Silent Mouths, clustered a few million kilometers beyond the gate. Instruments register a lane mouth and nothing beyond it.

bodies.name: Silent Mouth 2 (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the three Silent Mouths, clustered a few million kilometers beyond the gate. Instruments register a lane mouth and nothing beyond it.

bodies.name: Silent Mouth 3 (WIP)
bodies.notes: One of the three Silent Mouths, clustered a few million kilometers beyond the gate. Instruments register a lane mouth and nothing beyond it.

bodies.name: Tallis mouth
bodies.notes: Lane mouth to Tallis, one day.

bodies.name: Cinder picket
bodies.notes: Stewardship picket on the lanes out of Ostrom, heavily shielded against the pulsar. Cargo bound between arms pays the transit levy here; lattice pays one part in ten.

bodies.name: Gloam mouth
bodies.notes: Lane mouth to Gloam, six days.

bodies.name: Scald mouth
bodies.notes: Lane mouth to Scald, four days.

bodies.name: Marl's belt
bodies.notes: Thick asteroid belt. Source of most of the Marrow's raw material and of Ostrom's lattice.

bodies.name: Tallis
bodies.notes: The largest garden world in the Basin: mild and wet, with two continents and two small moons. Most people live in the river valleys down the larger continent's eastern side and along the coasts. The interior is a high, dry upland called the Reach, where the rains fail more years than they come. Absent machinery several kilometers down regulates the air and rainfall.

control.note: The Reach is contested; see its area.

bodies.name: Ostrom mouth
bodies.notes: Lane mouth to Ostrom, one day.

bodies.name: Brace picket
bodies.notes: Stewardship picket on the lane out of Tallis toward Halyard. Cargo bound between arms pays the transit levy here.

bodies.name: Halyard mouth
bodies.notes: Lane mouth to Halyard, three days.

bodies.name: Pennant mouth
bodies.notes: Mouth of the long lane to Pennant, five days.

places.name: Hangar Ring
places.notes: Docking ring big enough to take the Kestrel Accord. Run by Stewardship marines.

places.name: The Exchange
places.notes: Four kilometers of showrooms, brokers, bars and assay offices. The Exchange board, run by PATIENCE, carries most of the hired work in the Basin.

places.name: The Assay House
places.notes: At one end of the Exchange. Posts the lattice price the whole Basin quotes.

places.name: The Stacks
places.notes: Where most of the station's people live, in the asteroid's outer layers. Badly mapped even by station management. Thaw riots in 5026u; Hangar Ring bombed twice since.

places.name: Command
places.notes: Runs along the spine: Stewardship offices, the Bench's courts and the Allotment registry.

places.name: The Cold Hold
places.notes: The Bellwether's holds at the center of the station. About 140,000 colonists still asleep; the Navy wakes about four thousand a year.

places.name: Vigil chapel
places.notes: On the outer hull, facing the gate. The Vigil of the Open Door keeps its watch here.

places.name: The Landing
places.notes: First settlement on Tallis, put down on the east coast in 5017u. Its first winter killed about a third of the settlers. In 5019u Ivo Halloran seized its grain stores for nine days.

places.name: Tallis garrison
places.notes: Commodore Isaac Ferrante's command. Sweeps the Reach every dry season.
places._comment: Location near the Landing is invented.

places.name: Dry Creek
places.notes: Nineteen people died here in 5027u, six of them veterans, in a land dispute between Compact farmers and Navy veterans. The Reach went to war.

places.name: Sallow Ford
places.notes: The Compact held the town for eleven weeks in 5028u. CARILLON refused to direct the Severn's guns against it, and Ferrante retook it with ground artillery. Several hundred civilians died; Command suspended the Bench's inquiry.

areas.name: River valleys and east coast
areas.notes: Governed directly by the Stewardship. The best farmland in the Basin; the Riverlands Combine farms it and feeds the inner Basin.

areas.name: The Reach
areas.notes: High, dry interior upland. Governed on paper through appointed councils, most of which the Compact ignores. About twelve thousand Compact militia; the Landholders' League patrols its edge.

lanes.name: Ostrom – Gloam
lanes.notes: Longest lane out of the crossroads.

lanes.name: Silent Mouth 1 (WIP)
lanes.notes: The three Silent Mouths. Lane time unknown. Thought to be tidal on an unknown cycle and to run one way, into Ostrom. Drawn as tidal one-way on the chart.

lanes.name: Silent Mouth 2 (WIP)
lanes.notes: The three Silent Mouths. Lane time unknown. Thought to be tidal on an unknown cycle and to run one way, into Ostrom. Drawn as tidal one-way on the chart.

lanes.name: Silent Mouth 3 (WIP)
lanes.notes: The three Silent Mouths. Lane time unknown. Thought to be tidal on an unknown cycle and to run one way, into Ostrom. Drawn as tidal one-way on the chart.

lanes.name: Pennant – The Lantern Reach
lanes.notes: Only lane into the Lantern Reach.

lanes.name: Orison – The Orrery
lanes.notes: Halloran's Heirs thought to anchor along it.

lanes.name: The Wending passage
lanes.notes: Drift is fast; exit point moves month to month. Opens near Halyard Station.

lanes.name: The Sable Run
lanes.notes: Longest drifting lane in the inner Basin.

lanes.name: The Shoals – Halvard
lanes.notes: Only way out of the Shoals.

lanes.name: The Halvard Gap
lanes.notes: Opens near Halvard's ring system. Watched by six Mercer-Ibarra ships.

lanes.name: The Deeps – The Boneyard
lanes.notes: Only route home from the Deeps.
